Carmen: Quick heads-up — Sparrow (customer) private VPC cutover set for Thu 2026-04-08 02:00-02:30 UTC. Need final ops check and rollback owner.

Ryan: I'm oncall that window. I'll own rollback and rollback script is in infra/runbooks/sparrow-rollback.sh. Will test dry-run at 01:45 UTC.

Jia: I'll coordinate firewall NAT updates and route propagation. ETA for BGP withdraw is ~2m once triggered. Will document in the runbook.

Sasha: I'll run the post-cutover smoke tests (health /login, /api/generate, KV latency). Plan: run 0m, +5m, +15m. Sharing smoke script:
```
./scripts/smoke_sparrow.sh --endpoint https://sparrow.private.redwood
```

ops-bot: Cutover slot reserved for sparrow-customer from 2026-04-08T02:00Z to 2026-04-08T02:30Z. Reminder: set maintenance page if >5m expected interruption.

Carmen: Rolling hosts: app-3/app-4 -> migrate traffic, then purge kv cache. Expected p95 latency spike ~50ms. We should be able to roll back by reverting BGP and restoring old security group.

Ryan: Confirmed. Rollback procedure:
1) revert BGP announce
2) re-add old SG
3) failover DNS to previous LB
I can execute steps in ~12-18m if needed.

Jia: Firewall rule ID: fw-9843. I'll be on standby to revert in 3m.

Sasha: Noted. I'll kick off prebake of golden image at 01:10 UTC.

Carmen: Last checks: feature flags disabled? @ryan

Ryan: All prod feature flags for sparrow are off (ff/sparrow/*). Running quick config check now.

Ryan: config check OK. Also tagging @support for customer comms.

Support: acked. We'll send post-cutover confirmation once smoke passes +15m.

Carmen: Cool. If everyone is good, we'll proceed. Add any blockers now.

Jia: None from infra side.

Sasha: No blockers. I'll post smoke logs to the thread after run.

Ryan: I'll kick rollback dry-run at 01:45 and report.

Carmen: Thanks — standing by in case call needed. :thumbsup:
